title: Incident Follow-up
agenda:
Incident findings
Release gate
Monitoring follow-up
transcriptSegments: Checkout requests reached 1.2 seconds at p99 during the incident.
The vendor logs needed for root-cause analysis are still missing.
The team agreed that no release will ship until those logs arrive and the failure mode is understood.
Someone should investigate better monitoring next week, but we did not assign an owner or a deadline.
We do not yet know whether the database or the payment gateway caused the slowdown.
